needs.reason: the Opcode enum exists only after build.rs runs: its variants come from opcodes.txt through code the project executes at build time

traps: build.rs is found by convention, no build = key names it: it is a custom-build target compiled and run on the host before the library
src/lib.rs never defines Opcode: include! pulls $OUT_DIR/opcodes.rs, which does not exist in the tree
env!("OPCODES_MODERN_RUSTC") is set by a cargo:rustc-env line of build.rs; without running it the crate does not even compile
version_check is a build dependency: it is linked into build.rs, not into the library, and is not a runtime dependency
opcodes.txt is an input of the build script (rerun-if-changed), not documentation
